row: Veterinary Channel delivers expert guidance on veterinary medicine and pet health. Run by a practicing veterinarian, we demystify dog health, cat health, equine medicine and exotic animal care through clear tutorials and case studies. Our playlists cover everything from veterinary neurology, dermatology, cardiology, oncology and nutrition to endocrinology, pharmacology, toxicology and gastroenterology. You’ll also find vet school lectures, NAVLE and ECFVG review sessions, zoonotic disease discussions, public health topics and inspiring pet rescue stories. Short “veterinary capsules” offer quick tips, while longer lectures dive into internal medicine, surgery and behavioral issues. Whether you’re a veterinarian, student or pet owner, subscribe to learn, stay updated and join a community dedicated to better animal care
